objects.name: Story_text
objects.string: Hello, Converter. The hacker group Gridbreakers has infiltrated the power plant and compromised critical code by converting it into incorrect forms. It is up to you to convert the code to its proper state. We will contact you with updates, answer your questions, and warn you of any further changes made by the Gridbreakers. Good luck, Converter.
